text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Head of state General Sani Abacha creates six new states, making a total of 36.
- Former head of state and industrialist Ernest Shonekan heads Vision 2010 economic planning committee for next century.
- Government sets up eight-member panel to probe financial management and indebtedness of Daily Times newspaper publishers .
- Five political parties given approval by electoral commission.

- Contrary to bankers' wishes the central bank may have blocked plans by financial institutions to trade stabilisation securities at a discount. However bankers remain hopeful that the rules will be relaxed.
- Standards Organisation of Nigeria says all the salt sold in the country should be iodised by the year 2000.
